Phil S (Grumpy).html:
Supporting Evidence

The top of the funnel unclogged. Ad 01.01 went from 2 clicks to 9, its CTR nearly tripled to 2.99% (first time above the 2% floor), that traffic reached the page (LP views 1 → 4), and it produced the first real lead in GHL.

Ad 01.01 · 3-day trend

Metric 08.11 08.12 08.13
Spend $19.78 $25.99 $35.23
CTR 1.44% 0.69% 2.99%
CPC $6.59 $13.00 $3.91
Link Clicks 3 2 9
LP Views 2 1 4
GHL Leads 0 0 1

Against the short-term goal: 1 GHL lead on $35.23 (Ad 01.01), or $39.73 combined = a real CPL of ~$35–40 — still ~2× the $20 short-term target, but finite and measurable for the first time. Watch out for Meta's number: Meta CPL reads $8.81, which looks under goal — but that's Meta's "results" count (4), not actual GHL leads. On the source of truth (GHL = 1 lead), CPL is ~$35, not $8.81. The tracking gap persists (on-page Conversions/LP CR = 0 while GHL = 1; Visitors 54/14 vs LP Views 4/0), so treat the GHL lead as real and don't trust the on-page CR yet.

Hypotheses (1–3)

  1. The zero-results stretch was mostly a volume problem (higher confidence now). As clicks rose 2 → 9, a lead appeared. More qualified traffic should yield more leads.
  2. Ad 01.01 is the real engine; Ad 01.02 isn't competing (medium). 01.01 is improving (CTR↑, CPC↓, first lead) while 01.02 spends ~$4.50/day for 1 click — not enough to be a genuine test arm.
  3. On-page conversion tracking is under-counting (medium). GHL caught a lead the page/Meta did not, so the true LP CR is unknown and may be better than the 0% shown.

Recommended Action

  1. Keep scaling Ad 01.01 gradually — it's trending the right way. Feed it more budget/traffic to build a big-enough sample to pull CPL from ~$35 toward the $20 short-term goal, while watching that CPC and CPM stay reasonable (CPM jumped to $117 today).
  2. Fix on-page conversion tracking so LP CR reflects the GHL lead — we need a readable page CR to judge the 29% long-term target.
  3. Decide on Ad 01.02 — either fund it enough to actually compete, or pause it and consolidate budget into Ad 01.01.

Expected Result

If we scale Ad 01.01's qualified traffic and fix tracking, we'd expect multiple leads per day and CPL trending from ~$35 down toward the $20 short-term target, with a readable LP CR to benchmark against 29%. Sustained, that path is what supports the long-term 100–300 leads/month and 1–3 new clients.

Approval Needed

  • Needs your sign-off: how aggressively to scale Ad 01.01's budget.
  • Can proceed now: the on-page conversion tracking fix.
  • Decision for you: fund Ad 01.02 to make it a real test arm, or pause and consolidate into Ad 01.01?

Learning Captured

Open. Early 3-day trend: Ad 01.01 is improving on engagement (CTR↑, CPC↓) and produced the first lead on 08.13 — volume looks like the main lever so far. One lead isn't a trend yet; watch whether 08.14+ confirms it.
